A journey to discover the best biryani in India leads to a complex web of regional recipes and narratives. From Hyderabad to Kolkata, each city has its own unique biryani story, shaped by history, culture, and local ingredients. The search for the perfect biryani reveals a deeper connection to community, culture, and the power of food to bring people together.
